Title: Disable Windows Telemetry & Data Collection
Description: Stops Windows from collecting diagnostic data, usage telemetry, and sending usage logs to Microsoft servers.
ApplyScript: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection' -Name 'AllowTelemetry' -Type DWord -Value 0 -Force; Stop-Service 'DiagTrack' -WarningAction SilentlyContinue; Set-Service 'DiagTrack' -StartupType Disabled
RevertScript: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection' -Name 'AllowTelemetry' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Force; Set-Service 'DiagTrack' -StartupType Automatic; Start-Service 'DiagTrack' -WarningAction SilentlyContinue

Title: Disable Bing Search & Web Suggestions in Start Menu
Description: Prevents the Start Menu search from querying Bing and showing online ads or web search results, making local file search instant.

Title: Disable Advertising ID for Personalized Ads
Description: Prevents Windows and third-party apps from tracking your activity across apps for targeted advertising.

Title: Disable Activity History Tracking
Description: Prevents Windows from storing user timeline activities and uploading activity history to cloud servers.

Title: Enable Ultimate Performance Power Plan
Description: Unlocks the hidden Ultimate Performance power scheme which eliminates micro-latencies and keeps CPU cores responsive for heavy workloads and gaming.

Title: Disable Xbox Game DVR Background Recording
Description: Disables background video capture for games, freeing up GPU encoding resources and increasing frame rates.

Title: Enable Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling (HAGS)
Description: Allows the GPU to manage its own video memory directly, significantly reducing latency and improving game smoothness.

Title: Disable Network Throttling for Gaming & Media
Description: Windows limits non-multimedia network traffic to prevent packet flooding. Disabling it maximizes throughput and reduces ping in games.

Title: Remove Pre-installed Consumer Bloatware & Sponsored Apps
Description: Silently uninstalls third-party pre-loaded store apps like TikTok, Disney, Candy Crush, Solitaire collection, and Spotify promo packages.
ApplyScript: $bloat = @('*CandyCrush*', '*TikTok*', '*Disney*', '*SpotifyAB*', '*Amazon*', '*Facebook*', '*Twitter*', '*EclipseManager*'); foreach ($app in $bloat) { Get-AppxPackage -Name $app -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-AppxPackage -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
RevertScript: Write-Output 'Apps can be reinstalled from Microsoft Store if desired.'

Title: Remove Deprecated Cortana App
Description: Removes the standalone Cortana application which Microsoft has retired.

Title: Remove Feedback Hub & Tips
Description: Removes Windows Tips, Feedback Hub, and 'Get Help' background prompts.
ApplyScript: Get-AppxPackage -Name '*WindowsFeedbackHub*' -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-AppxPackage -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Get-AppxPackage -Name '*GetHelp*' -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-AppxPackage -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
RevertScript: Write-Output 'Can be reinstalled from Microsoft Store.'

Title: Restore Classic Windows 10 Right-Click Context Menu (Win 11)
Description: Brings back the full, immediate right-click context menu without needing to click 'Show more options' every time.

Title: Show Known File Extensions in File Explorer
Description: Always displays file extensions (.exe, .txt, .zip, etc.) so you can identify real file types and avoid malicious spoofed extensions.

Title: Show Hidden Files & Folders in File Explorer
Description: Displays hidden system files and folders like AppData in File Explorer.

Title: Disable Nagle's Algorithm (TcpAckFrequency & TCPNoDelay)
Description: Eliminates network buffering delays for TCP packets to minimize packet ping latency in online multiplayer games.
ApplyScript: $adapters = Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces\*'; foreach ($a in $adapters) { Set-ItemProperty -Path $a.PSPath -Name 'TcpAckFrequency' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path $a.PSPath -Name 'TCPNoDelay' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Force }
RevertScript: $adapters = Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces\*'; foreach ($a in $adapters) { Remove-ItemProperty -Path $a.PSPath -Name 'TcpAckFrequency' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-ItemProperty -Path $a.PSPath -Name 'TCPNoDelay' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

Title: Disable Sticky Keys 5x Shift Shortcut Popup
Description: Prevents the annoying accessibility Sticky Keys popup from interrupting fullscreen games when pressing the Shift key rapidly.

Title: Disable Windows Telemetry Scheduled Tasks
Description: Disables background scheduled tasks that gather hardware metrics, CEIP telemetry, and application experience data.
ApplyScript: $tasks = @('\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser', '\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\ProgramDataUpdater', '\Microsoft\Windows\Autochk\Proxy', '\Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\Consolidator', '\Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\UsbCeip', '\Microsoft\Windows\DiskDiagnostic\Microsoft-Windows-DiskDiagnosticDataCollector'); foreach ($t in $tasks) { Disable-ScheduledTask -TaskName $t -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
RevertScript: $tasks = @('\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser', '\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\ProgramDataUpdater', '\Microsoft\Windows\Autochk\Proxy', '\Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\Consolidator', '\Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\UsbCeip', '\Microsoft\Windows\DiskDiagnostic\Microsoft-Windows-DiskDiagnosticDataCollector'); foreach ($t in $tasks) { Enable-ScheduledTask -TaskName $t -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
